description: Differences expected between ANY relocated (Nix-native) build and the official RPMs, for every check of tools/nn-parity.py (always loaded, rules optional). Package-specific effects go to tools/parity/nn-<srpm>-<check>.json. Every rule names its cause in 'effect'.

allow.reason: the transient RPMs that the partitioner reads are written with %_binary_payload w0.ufdio (lib/rocky/rpm/macros.nix-reloc, design §1.2): rpm adds the rpmlib(PayloadIsZstd) dependency only for zstd payloads. The payload is never shipped (the BUILDROOT has the bytes)
